items.headline: Arkansas State fires Butch Jones, names Jalen Ortiz interim coach
items.description: The Arkansas State Red Wolves have fired head coach Butch Jones, effective immediately, and named Jalen Ortiz as interim coach the remainder of the season.

items.headline: 2026 college football coaching carousel: Tracking every open job
items.description: As the carousel spins, we'll keep you updated with all the comings and goings.

items.headline: Sources: Arkansas State tells Butch Jones he's out at end of year
items.description: Arkansas State has informed football coach Butch Jones that he's out at the end of the season, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel on Monday night.

items.headline: Louisiana Tech takes on Arkansas State in Sun Belt action
items.description: Arkansas State (4-6) at Louisiana Tech (8-2), Nov. 21 at 7 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Deuce Bailey and Chanticleers' defense power Coastal Carolina over Arkansas St. 28-21
items.description: — Deuce Bailey completed 21 of 24 passes for 208 yards and a touchdown and added his first rushing score of the season as Coastal Carolina beat Arkansas State 28-21 on Saturday.
